title: 7.8 Help and Important Phrases
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Say I need help, say that I do not understand, and ask someone to repeat or to speak slowly.
grammar_function: I need help. I do not understand. Please repeat. Please speak slowly.
prerequisite: 5.9 please and thank you; 6.7 Excuse me. and Can you help me?; 4.1 bathroom; 4.3 Where is ...?
speaking_outcome: Ask for help and ask someone to repeat.
